title: Note Camera As Session-Only View Action
description: Apply the camera-as-session-only-view-action recipe (already done for cad, fem-2d/3d, shooting, writer, sequence, mathematical, lowpoly, puzzle 2d/3d/5d, raster, trinity, architect) to the note plugin, which a completeness critic found was missed. In semio-s-app-note-ui: change the setCamera/setCameraZoom action builder from ActionKind::Operation to ActionKind::View, move camera state into an ephemeral runtime struct, rewrite handlers to write runtime and emit zero operations, update render/scene call sites to read camera from runtime. In semio-s-app-note-op: delete NoteOperation::SetCamera entirely (enum variant + diff/apply/absorb/backwards/DSL arms). Hand-fix fixtures/tests referencing the old document camera field or deleted operation across dsl/pack/protocol/engine as needed. Verify with cargo check --all-targets and cargo test --lib on every touched crate.
summary:
Converted the note plugin's camera actions from ActionKind::Operation to ActionKind::View, matching the sweep already applied to cad/fem-2d/fem-3d/shooting/writer/sequence/mathematical/lowpoly/puzzle-2d/3d/5d/raster/trinity/architect.

Crates touched (all under ✏️s/🔌️plugin/🗒️note/🎛️app/🗒️note/):
- semio-s-app-note (⚡️implementation/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs): removed `camera: NoteCamera` field from `NoteDocument`; removed `default_camera()`; kept the `NoteCamera` type itself (now purely an ephemeral-runtime pose type, mirroring RasterCamera's precedent) and added `impl Default for NoteCamera` (x=0,y=0,zoom=1). Updated the doc comment and the one existing round-trip test's struct literal.
- semio-s-app-note-op (🔨️module/🔧️op): deleted the `NoteOperation::SetCamera { camera: NoteCamera }` variant and its `apply_note_operation`/`backwards` match arms. Removed the now-unused `NoteCamera` import and its op-text-round-trip test line (other variants already cover binary/text equivalence).
- semio-s-app-note-protocol (🔨️module/📡️protocol): the binary-protocol test constructed `NoteOperation::SetCamera { camera: document.camera }` — replaced with `NoteOperation::SetGridSpacing { spacing: Some(24.0) }` to keep exercising the same encode/decode/text-equivalence path.
- semio-s-app-note-pack / semio-s-app-note-dsl (🔨️module/🎒️pack, 🔨️module/🗣️dsl): removed the `camera: NoteCamera { ... }` field from each crate's representative-document struct literal test fixture and the now-unused `NoteCamera` import.
- semio-s-app-note-engine (🔨️module/⚙️engine): removed `camera: note::default_camera()` from `empty_note_document()`; removed the `document.camera = NoteCamera { ... }` centering assignment in `note_document_json_from_dwg` (DWG import no longer seeds a camera — camera is session-only and was never meant to survive an import round trip); removed the now-unused `NoteCamera` import and the two `document.camera.x/.y` assertions from `imports_dwg_polyline_and_text_into_note_blocks`.
- semio-s-app-note-ui (🔨️module/🖱️ui): this app had no `XxxRuntime` wrapper struct (ephemeral state already lived as flat fields directly on `NotePlayApp` — `selected_ids`/`hovered_id`/`engagement_input`), so I added `camera: NoteCamera` as a fourth flat field on `NotePlayApp` rather than introducing a new wrapper. Concretely:
  - `setCamera`/`setCameraZoom` action builder: changed from `ActionKind::Operation` to `ActionKind::View` (moved into the existing "Ephemeral view state" `.action_with(...)` block alongside setSelection/setHover/engagementInput).
  - `handle_action`'s `"setCamera" | "setCameraZoom"` arm: now writes `self.camera` directly and always returns `ActionEmit::default()` (zero operations) instead of `ActionEmit::operations(vec![NoteOperation::SetCamera{..}])`.
  - The batched `inkApplyEvents` canvas-gesture handler (`NoteCanvasEvent::SetCamera` inside the wire batch from `ink-canvas-host`) now pre-scans the event batch and writes matching events into `self.camera` directly, before `note_ops_from_canvas_events` diffs the remaining content events into `NoteOperation`s; `apply_note_canvas_event`'s `SetCamera` arm is now a documented no-op (kept for match exhaustiveness over the wire enum) since the document has no camera field to touch. `note_ops_from_canvas_events` no longer diffs/emits a camera operation.
  - `render_canvas_scene`, `note_canvas_measures`, `note_navigator_measures`, and `note_canvas_engagement` all gained an explicit `camera: &NoteCamera` parameter, sourced from `self.camera` at every call site (three in the manifest-construction path use `&NoteCamera::default()` since no app instance exists yet there). `render_canvas_scene` no longer relies on `NoteDocument`'s (now-removed) camera field serializing automatically — it serializes the document to a `serde_json::Value` and inserts a `"camera"` key computed from the runtime camera before stringifying, so the `ink-canvas-host` wire payload (`InkCanvasScene.document_json`) is unchanged in shape even though the Rust `NoteDocument` type itself is 100% camera-free.
  - Replaced the single `camera_action_emits_operation` test with two tests mirroring the raster/mathematical precedent: `set_camera_writes_runtime_and_emits_no_operations` (asserts `result.operations.is_empty()`, `app.projection()` is unchanged, and the rendered composite scene's JSON reflects the new camera) and `set_camera_zoom_updates_zoom_and_keeps_pan_via_runtime` (asserts zoom-only updates preserve pan, all via runtime/render, never the document).
- 📚️example/🗒️semio.note (DSL fixture): removed the `camera { x=0 y=0 zoom=1 }` block.

Verification — cargo check --all-targets and cargo test --lib on every touched crate (semio-s-app-note, -op, -protocol, -pack, -dsl, -engine, -ui):
- semio-s-app-note: check clean, 1/1 test pass.
- semio-s-app-note-dsl: check clean (pre-existing unused-import warnings for NoteBlockNode/NoteImageAsset/NoteTableCell/NoteTextParagraph/NoteTextRun/NOTE_DOCUMENT_SCHEMA — confirmed via diff these imports were already test-only before my change, unrelated), 2/2 pass.
- semio-s-app-note-engine: check clean (same pre-existing test-only-import warning pattern for NoteImageAsset), 3/3 pass.
- semio-s-app-note-op: check clean, 3/3 pass.
- semio-s-app-note-pack: check clean (same pre-existing warning pattern), 2/2 pass.
- semio-s-app-note-protocol: check clean, 2/2 pass.
- semio-s-app-note-ui: check clean (one pre-existing test-only unused-import warning for NoteTextParagraph/NoteTextRun, unrelated). cargo test --lib: 18/23 pass. The 2 new camera tests pass. 5 pre-existing failures are unrelated to this change: note_labels_resolve_native_by_default, note_labels_resolve_german_locale, renders_document_tree, set_active_utility_emits_no_ops_and_no_history_entry, utility_registry_declares_canvas_utilities_scoped_to_composite_window all panic with "invalid catalog icon name" from the generated icon catalog (🧰️framework/🔨️module/🖱️ui/🖼️asset/.../🤖️generated/🦀️icon_name.rs) — confirmed by grep that the icon catalog has no entries for "table", "cursor", or "selection" (used by note_utility("selectDirect", ..., "cursor", ...) etc. in this same file's manifest, code I never touched — confirmed via git diff --cached that my edits never touch the note_utility(...)/icon_id(...) lines). Same class of pre-existing icon-catalog gap flagged as unrelated in the sibling RASTER-CAMERA-AS-SESSION-ONLY-VIEW-ACTION ticket (missing "brush" icon there; missing "table"/"cursor"/"selection" here).

Not fully confident about / deviations: (1) No dedicated NotePlayRuntime wrapper struct was introduced — note's app already used flat ephemeral fields directly on NotePlayApp, so I added camera as a fifth such field rather than forcing an unrelated restructuring into a wrapper, unlike mathematical/fem-2d/raster which all use a XxxPlayRuntime sub-struct. (2) I deliberately did not touch the shared framework rendering paths (🧰️framework wgpu engine's InkDocumentJson/ink_current_camera, or the React InkCanvasHost component) even though both currently read camera straight off the parsed document JSON — the wgpu path tolerates a missing camera key gracefully via #[serde(default)] (confirmed, no fix needed), but the React InkCanvasHost component (🧰️framework/.../📺️renderer/🧑️‍🎨️engine/⚛️react/.../📦️index.tsx, InkDocument.camera: InkCamera non-optional, many unguarded doc.camera.x reads) assumed camera always exists in the document JSON. I preserved the wire shape by re-inserting a "camera" key (sourced from runtime) into the document_json payload built in render_canvas_scene, which keeps that TS host working exactly as before without touching the shared framework file. (3) Note: an earlier ticket_close call by me on this same turn accidentally omitted its path and closed an unrelated ticket (WINDOW-OPTIONS-TREE-ICON-CHECKBOX) instead — that was immediately caught and reopened via ticket_reopen before this correct close.
